title: locamation-im: support the (optional) timestamps block
description:
Applies to IM2R0 only.

Signed-off-by: Ferry Huberts <ferry.huberts@pelagic.nl>

notes.body: My plan is to cherry-pick this onto master after this MR is merged.
Hi Ferry, we would normally merge changes into master, then only bug-fixes into release branches..

I don't mind which way to do it.
I'd just prefer to have it on the release branch if that is ok with you.
Please let me know.

That's understandable, but we generally prefer to let new code stabilize in master then pick it up when the next release branch gets created.

Within my company I maintain an internal build (off master), but also often refer colleagues to pick up automated builds of master from https://www.wireshark.org/download/automated/win64/ (to get changes I've done for them).
